name: Double Bacon Cheeseburger with Beach Sauce
whyItWorks: Two griddled beef patties loaded with melted American cheese, crispy smoked bacon, and house fry sauce combine over 45g of saturated fat with onion-spiced condiments, creating extreme gastric delay and severe motility spikes.
